hero.title: Run property management
hero.description: Domera brings your daily operations into one smart platform. Meter readings, billing, resident communication, documents and reports work together, so your team spends less time on administration and more time delivering great service.

whyDomera.title: Give every team more time for real service
whyDomera.description: Domera removes the repetitive work that slows property management teams down: manual calculations, scattered files and resident calls that should be self-service.

automation.title: Save hours every week
automation.description: Automate repetitive tasks, reduce manual calculations and keep monthly work moving without spreadsheet checks.

cloud.title: Everything in one place
cloud.description: Properties, apartments, residents, invoices and documents stay available from one connected dashboard.

transparency.title: Built for modern property management
transparency.description: Secure cloud infrastructure, automatic updates and access from any device keep the team moving.

security.title: Clear roles, safer work
security.description: Managers, accountants, owners and residents see the right tools and data without crossing permissions.

features.title: One platform. Every building.
features.description: Managing properties shouldn't require five different programs. Domera gives your team one connected workspace where billing, maintenance, resident communication and reporting happen together.

properties.title: Properties, apartments and residents
properties.description: Keep every building, unit, owner and resident profile organized in a registry your whole team can trust.

meters.title: Meter readings
meters.description: Collect readings, review consumption history and send reminders without chasing files or calls.

payments.title: Billing and payments
payments.description: Create invoices, track payment status and see debts clearly for every building.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Contracts, invoices, acts and apartment files are available to the right people at the right time.

communication.title: Resident communication
communication.description: Send news, reminders and important updates from the same workspace your team already uses.

security.title: Roles and security
security.description: Give administrators, accountants, owners and residents access that matches their work.

platform.title: Less administration. More transparency. Better service.

solutions.title: A calmer experience for teams and residents
solutions.description: Everyone gets the information they need without extra calls, repeated questions or files sent through chat.

companies.title: Management companies
companies.description: A single operations center for buildings, residents, billing, debts and documents.

teams.title: Building administrators
teams.description: Requests, notifications and work history stay tied to the right building and apartment.

residents.title: Residents and owners
residents.description: Residents can submit meter readings, receive invoices, review payment history and stay informed without calling the office.

pricing.title: Simple & Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: Pay only for the apartments you manage. No hidden fees, no setup costs, no minimum monthly payment.

calculator.label: Pricing calculator
calculator.hint: Move the slider or type your portfolio size.

info.title: Simple. Fair. Scalable.
info.description: Domera uses one of the simplest pricing models in the PropTech industry. You only pay for the apartments you actively manage. There are no hidden fees, expensive packages, or mandatory upgrades. As your portfolio grows, your monthly price scales automatically while remaining completely transparent.

faq.title: Short answers about rollout
faq.description: Common questions before moving building management into Domera.

install.question: Can we start without installation?
install.answer: Yes. Domera runs in the cloud, so your team only needs a browser and an account.

multiple.question: Does it work for multiple buildings?
multiple.answer: Yes. You can separate buildings, apartments, staff roles and resident access.

documents.question: What happens to documents and invoices?
documents.answer: Files are stored against properties and apartments, and access can be limited by role.

residents.question: Can residents be connected gradually?
residents.answer: Yes. You can first use Domera internally and invite residents when the team is ready.
